hero.title: EdLight Summer Leadership Program
hero.subtitle: A two-week hybrid leadership experience equipping Haitian secondary students with the tools to become engaged leaders and future citizens.

stats.title: The flagship leadership experience for Haitian teens
stats.subtitle: Since 2022, ESLP has combined world-class facilitation, real-world exposure, and a vibrant alumni network so young leaders can transform their ideas into action.

whatIs.title: What is the EdLight Summer Leadership Program?
whatIs.subtitle: Launched in August 2022, ESLP is a two-week summer programme for secondary students in Haiti designed to strengthen leadership, civic awareness, and future readiness.
whatIs.p1: ESLP complements academic learning with a focused journey through leadership, entrepreneurship, personal development, civic engagement, and global opportunity awareness. Fellows reflect on both local and international issues while building the confidence to lead in their schools and communities.
whatIs.p2: The 2026 edition ran as a hybrid experience: most sessions took place online, followed by a company excursion to Radio Télé Métropole in Port-au-Prince and a closing graduation day at IICA in Pétion-Ville, where 35 fellows received their certificates. We have welcomed speakers from leading organizations and institutions — including Harvard, MIT, Microsoft, Deutsche Bank, and Cornell — who join fellows to share expertise, challenge assumptions, and inspire action.

experience.title: Inside the ESLP experience
experience.subtitle: High-energy days blend virtual seminars, collaborative projects, mentor access, and a curated in-person company visit.

leadershipStudios.title: Leadership studios
leadershipStudios.description: Interactive sessions on personal leadership, social innovation, public speaking, and collaborative problem solving.

masterclasses.title: Masterclasses & mentors
masterclasses.description: Facilitated by Haitian and international leaders from Harvard, MIT, Deutsche Bank, Microsoft, and more.

cityImmersions.title: City immersions
cityImmersions.description: A featured company visit in Port-au-Prince — Radio Télé Métropole in 2026 — helps fellows connect leadership learning to real workplace expectations.

pitchNight.title: Impact pitch night
pitchNight.description: Cohort teams design initiatives for Haitian communities and present them to a panel of mentors and partners.

capstone.title: Capstone Challenge Week
capstone.body: Fellows collaborate in multidisciplinary squads of 4–5 to design solutions for local challenges. Each team is paired with an experienced mentor in entrepreneurship and project development. They complete stakeholder interviews, prototype ideas, and present an actionable roadmap during the closing pitch night in front of families, alumni, and partners.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.subtitle: The ESLP curriculum focuses on five core areas spread across the two-week program. For each topic, we invite expert speakers from leading institutions.
curriculum.note: In parallel, students are grouped into teams and challenged to develop a project that addresses a specific need in their community. The program also includes an excursion to a major company in Port-au-Prince, allowing students to gain real-world insights into workplace dynamics, innovation, and leadership in action.

personalDiscovery.title: Personal Discovery
personalDiscovery.description: Self-awareness, leadership styles, values mapping, and public speaking.

professionalOrientation.title: Professional Orientation
professionalOrientation.description: Career exploration, résumé clinics, and mentorship from industry professionals.

collegeAdmissions.title: College Admissions & Scholarships
collegeAdmissions.description: Guidance on studying abroad in the USA, Canada, France, Taiwan, Morocco, and more.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Personal finance, budgeting, saving, and understanding the economic landscape.

entrepreneurship.title: Entrepreneurship
entrepreneurship.description: Business model canvas, market research, prototyping, and the final capstone pitch.

tabs.title: Experience the curriculum
tabs.subtitle: From virtual seminars with world-class speakers to hands-on excursions and a celebration of achievement.

seminars.label: Seminars
seminars.alt: ESLP virtual seminar session — fellows and speakers on a Zoom call
seminars.heading: Interactive virtual seminars
seminars.description: From 9 AM to 12 PM, fellows meet virtually with expert speakers from institutions like Harvard, MIT, Cornell, Deutsche Bank, and Microsoft. Interactive sessions cover leadership, personal development, college admissions, finance, and entrepreneurship — offering students a platform to engage directly with industry leaders.

excursion.label: Excursion
excursion.alt: ESLP 2026 fellows on the news set during their visit to Radio Télé Métropole in Port-au-Prince
excursion.heading: Real-world company visits
excursion.description: The program includes an enriching excursion to a prominent company in Port-au-Prince — in 2026, fellows spent a day at Radio Télé Métropole, exchanging with journalists and touring the newsroom, studios, and control room. Transportation and entries are fully covered for every fellow.

graduation.label: Graduation
graduation.alt: The 35 graduated fellows of ESLP 2026 holding their certificates at IICA in Pétion-Ville
graduation.heading: Capstone showcase & ceremony
graduation.description: The program culminates in a capstone pitch showcase where cohort teams present their community initiatives to a panel of mentors, partners, and families. In 2026, 35 fellows graduated at IICA in Pétion-Ville, receiving certificates of distinction recognizing their leadership, collaboration, and successful completion of projects.

journey.title: From application to alumni leadership
journey.intro: ESLP is designed as a guided journey. Fellows receive holistic support at every phase — from recruitment to post-program mentorship.

eligibility.title: Eligibility & selection
eligibility.subtitle: We're looking for young leaders who are eager to learn, collaborate, and serve their communities.

items.age: Students aged 15–18 currently enrolled in a Haitian high school.
items.qualities: Learners who demonstrate curiosity, teamwork, empathy, and leadership potential.
items.commitment: Participants committed to attending every session, workshop, and excursion.

selection.title: How we select fellows
selection.intro: ESLP is highly competitive. We evaluate each application holistically to build a diverse, mission-aligned cohort of ~30 students.

criteria.motivation: Motivation, character, and alignment with EdLight's mission
criteria.community: Community involvement or leadership in clubs, faith groups, or initiatives
criteria.curiosity: Academic curiosity, discipline, and willingness to learn
criteria.representation: Balanced representation across regions, schools, and gender

apply.title: How to apply
apply.subtitle: Applications are closed. When {cycle} opens in {opens}, this is what you will need to submit:

form.title: Application Form
form.desc: Fill out the form with your name, address, school information, and more.

essays.title: Two Essays

cohort2026.title: ESLP 2026
cohort2026.body: The 2026 edition of the EdLight Summer Leadership Program ran {dates} — two weeks of virtual seminars, a company excursion to Radio Télé Métropole in Port-au-Prince, and a graduation ceremony at IICA in Pétion-Ville where 35 fellows received their certificates. Applications for ESLP 2027 will open in {opens}.

funding.title: Fully funded for every fellow
funding.subtitle: ESLP is powered by partners and donors who believe that leadership development should be accessible.
funding.guaranteeBody: Every fellow attends ESLP tuition-free. Sponsors help cover core learning costs, selected logistics for in-person moments, and continued support for alumni growth.

allInclusive.title: All-inclusive experience
allInclusive.description: Workshops, curriculum materials, supplies, and daily meals provided for every fellow.

excursions.title: Excursions & cultural labs
excursions.description: Transportation and entries for site visits, service projects, and cultural events covered in full.

mentors.title: Mentors & alumni network
mentors.description: Access to industry mentors plus ongoing guidance from ESLP alumni after graduation.

certificate.title: Certificate of distinction
certificate.description: Recognizes leadership, collaboration, and successful completion of capstone projects.

testimonials.title: Voices from our alumni
testimonials.subtitle: Meet the inspiring faces of our past participants. Through ESLP, they have honed their skills, gained invaluable insights, and forged lifelong connections.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Need more details? Email {email} and our team will follow up within two business days.

dates.question: When does the next cohort take place?
dates.answer: The 2026 edition ran {dates} and concluded with 35 fellows graduating at IICA in Pétion-Ville. Applications for ESLP 2027 will open in {opens} — join the notify list to hear first.

free.question: Is the program really free?
free.answer: Yes. Thanks to generous partners and sponsors, ESLP covers core program costs including learning sessions, materials, the organized excursion, and the closing celebration.

documents.question: What documents will I need to apply?
documents.answer: Typically you submit: (1) an application form, (2) two essays — one about your extracurricular activities and another about your interest in the program, (3) a recent ID picture, and (4) your current academic transcripts as a PDF.

english.question: Do fellows need to speak English?
english.answer: No. The program is designed for Haitian students and core communication is accessible in Kreyòl and French, while some guest speakers may also engage in English.

prepare.question: What do I need to prepare before the program?
prepare.answer: You will need a laptop, tablet, or phone with a camera, a stable internet connection, a quiet well-lit space, and a notebook with pens or pencils for daily activities.

organizations.question: How can organizations get involved?
organizations.answer: Organizations can mentor a session, host an excursion, provide scholarships, or offer internships to ESLP alumni. Reach out to {email} to co-create a partnership.

finalCta.title: Ready to lead with purpose?
finalCta.body: Join the notify list for the 2027 cohort, nominate a student, or partner with ESLP to support the next generation of Haitian leaders.
